Pain is part of every goal worth chasing.

Kevin Trudeau says life is a game, and every game has pushback. Whether you want to grow, improve a relationship or earn more, there will be pain along the way.

He shares the Buddha's line: pain is inevitable, but suffering is optional. Successful people, he says, don't keep their focus on the problem.

When did you last let pain talk you out of something you wanted?

#ad #mindset #success #kevintrudeau

A problem can scare one person and fire up another.

Kevin Trudeau says step one is how you react to adversity. A winner gets fired up, motivated and ready for a fight. A loser caves in and says, "Oh no, how am I going to deal with this?"

He calls it a mindset, and the same problem can look very different depending on yours.

Which reaction shows up first in you?

#ad #mindset #success #kevintrudeau

One quality overcomes almost everything, even nature.

Kevin Trudeau asks how you overcome adversity. His first answer is persistence and perseverance.

He quotes John D. Rockefeller, who said no other quality is so essential to success of any kind. In Rockefeller's words, it overcomes almost everything.

Where in your life do you most need to keep going?

#ad #success #habits #kevintrudeau
